atomic_facts: Researchers identified a specific population of cells, called GEPCOT cells, that are highly active and short-lived in the mouse brain.

evidence_packets.source_span: In contrast , pre-GEPCOT cells were quiescent... were long-lived in vivo . While GEPCOT NICs were ablated by temozolomide , pre-GEPCOT cells survived and repopulated the SVZ .
atomic_facts: The study identified 'pre-GEPCOT' cells as the true quiescent neural stem cells that are long-lived and survive chemotherapy-like treatments.

evidence_packets.source_span: The pre-GEPCOTs accounted for 6 ± 3% of adult mouse SVZ cells , were highly quiescent... These cells contained long-lived qNSCs based on both fate mapping and temozolomide resistance .
atomic_facts: Pre-GEPCOT cells in the adult mouse brain are highly quiescent and contain long-lived quiescent neural stem cells (qNSCs).

evidence_packets.source_span: GEPCOTs... were highly mitotically active , highly enriched for NICs , and included type C cells based on marker expression , morphology , and position in vivo .
atomic_facts: GEPCOT cells in the adult mouse brain are highly mitotically active and are enriched for neural-initiating cells (NICs).

evidence_packets.source_span: We found 17 markers that enriched NICs relative to unfractionated SVZ cells... We multiplexed combinations of these markers to optimize enrichment
atomic_facts: Researchers identified 17 cell surface markers that can be used to enrich and isolate neural-initiating cells from the adult mouse subventricular zone.

evidence_packets.source_span: GEPCOTs are thus highly mitotically active and enriched for dividing cells... nearly all GEPCOTs incorporated BrdU within 24 hr indicates that few, if any, GEPCOTs are quiescent
atomic_facts: GEPCOT cells are highly active and divide frequently in the living brain, with nearly all cells dividing within a 24-hour period.

evidence_packets.source_span: Individual NICs persist only transiently within the SVZ in vivo but are constantly replenished by more primitive neural stem cells.
atomic_facts: Individual neurosphere-initiating cells (NICs) only persist for a short time in the brain before being replaced.

evidence_packets.source_span: These data indicate that pre-GEPCOT cells are quiescent in the SVZ.
atomic_facts: Pre-GEPCOT cells in the subventricular zone (SVZ) are quiescent, meaning they do not divide frequently in vivo.

evidence_packets.source_span: Whereas GEPCOTs were highly enriched for multipotent NICs ( Figure 1C ) , pre-GEPCOTs were unable to form neurospheres.
atomic_facts: Unlike GEPCOT cells, pre-GEPCOT cells are unable to form neurospheres or colonies in culture.

evidence_packets.source_span: Thus all of the CreERT2 alleles that gave a sustained contribution to NIC and SVZ labeling also labeled pre-GEPCOTs , consistent with the suggestion that pre-GEPCOT cells contain qNSCs.
atomic_facts: Genetic markers that provide long-term contributions to the subventricular zone (SVZ) also label pre-GEPCOT cells.

evidence_packets.source_span: we identified two phenotypically and functionally distinct populations of neural stem/progenitor cells from the adult mouse SVZ... GEPCOT cells were... highly mitotically active in vivo... In contrast, pre-GEPCOT cells... were quiescent in vivo
atomic_facts: Researchers identified two distinct types of neural stem cells in the adult mouse brain: quiescent (dormant) pre-GEPCOT cells and highly active GEPCOT cells.
